assets.name: Goblin skirmisher token (example)
assets.prompt: A wiry goblin skirmisher crouched with a jagged short sword, seen from a top-down 3/4 angle, centered. Hand-inked fantasy illustration, warm candlelit palette, bold readable silhouette, clean outline. Square image, transparent background, no text.
variants: Same goblin skirmisher, mid-leap, sword raised. Hand-inked fantasy illustration, warm candlelit palette, bold readable silhouette. Square, transparent background, no text.

assets.name: d20 roll icon (example)
assets.prompt: A single twenty-sided die with the 20 facing up, centered, simple shapes. Hand-inked fantasy illustration, warm candlelit palette, thick clean outline, readable at 24 pixels. Square image, transparent background, no text other than the number.
